versions.content: Configuration check If a configuration contains a TmPreDef- TimerInstance where the TmTimerUser equals PORT and the TmPreDefTimer- Type is not equal TM_PREDEF_TIMER_1US_32BIT then the generator tool of the Time Service module shall report an error.
